# LangChain API Reference

> Comprehensive API documentation for LangChain Python and JavaScript libraries.
> LangChain is a framework for building applications with large language models (LLMs),
> including chains, agents, RAG pipelines, and tool-calling workflows.

Important notes:
- Python packages require Python 3.9+
- JavaScript packages require Node.js 18+
- Most LLM integrations require API keys from the respective providers
- All pages are available as markdown by appending `.md` to the URL

## Accessing Documentation

All pages support markdown format for AI consumption:

**URL patterns:**

- Package overview: `https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain-core.md`
- Symbol page: `https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain-core/RunnableSequence.md`
- Nested symbol: `https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain-core/RunnableSequence/invoke.md`

Markdown is also served automatically when:
- `Accept: text/markdown` header is present
- User-Agent matches LLM patterns (GPTBot, Claude-Web, cursor, copilot)
- Request is from CLI tools (curl, wget, httpie)

## MCP Server

This documentation is available as an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server
for integration with AI coding assistants:

`https://reference.langchain.com/mcp`

Compatible with Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop, and other MCP clients.
